figurative_meaning_bn: অতিশয়তার ভাব- সু-অর্থে অতিপ্রশংসা; কু-অর্থে অতিনিন্দা; সাধারণভাবে প্রশংসায় মুখর হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: Conveys excessiveness - in positive sense, excessive praise; in negative sense, excessive criticism; generally, being vocally effusive in praise
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাফল্যে সকলে পঞ্চমুখ হয়ে প্রশংসা করতে লাগল।
শত্রুরা তাকে পঞ্চমুখে নিন্দা করে চলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone became five-mouthed in praising his success.
His enemies are five-mouthed in criticizing him.
history: Referenced in Bharat Chandra Ray's works as 'কুকথায় পঞ্চমুখ' to denote excessive criticism; may allude to the five-faced form of Lord Shiva in Hindu mythology.
note: The idiom draws from literary and mythological roots, often used in formal or poetic contexts.
